review: Fresh isolated replay exactly reproduces the diagnostic from the captured state and inventory inputs. Current workflow state is P2_EXECUTING: G1_TARGET_AND_INVENTORY passed; G2 through G6 are not_run. The inventory contains 33 image records and 70 coverage rows, summarized across 40 scopes with no partition discontinuities. The four canonical function/data/interface/freeze records are absent at the campaign and inventory roots checked by the script.
interpretation: This describes canonical inventory and current workflow gate state only. The absent canonical records do not mean no analysis exists: many private partial P2 maps and fixtures are stored under the campaign analysis tree, and those are not admitted into canonical coverage by this diagnostic.
limitations: The diagnostic reads only workflow state and the three specified inventory inputs; it does not inspect private analysis artifacts for admission or completeness.
It does not change gates, establish semantic completeness, or define a freeze denominator.
Historical inventory/status.json is not treated as current gate authority.
